scope: Independent Japanese rules and terminology re-audit of 4561 Pocket cards; no new source translation.

finding.rootCause: An English singular article hid an unnamed Num:Int value; the renderer failed to restore the required explicit Japanese 1. Missing numeric bindings had silently rendered as empty strings.
finding.onlyChange: All 149 textual edits insert the ASCII digit 1; no other text is changed.
finding.replay: rules-resolved regenerated from the same pinned master/dictionaries with the fixed renderer; 4561 resolved, zero unresolved.
finding.specialEvidence: B4b-012 and B4b-410 canonical English also omitted the article. Both native images were manually viewed; they print Grass Energy count 1. Their explicit reviewed overrides are separate from the immutable original rules evidence.

evidenceLimits: 142 corrected card OCR records contain an explicit 1 with a Japanese counter. This is a cross-check, not an exact whole-field OCR transcript. The remaining four low-OCR images were manually viewed; B4b-012 was also manually viewed. Source dictionary grammatical singular branches provide independent rendering evidence.
